items.prompt: Why does the one-dimensional 0/1 knapsack scan capacities downward for each positive-weight item?

options.text: So the same item can be reused until capacity is filled
options.why: That changes 0/1 use into a different recurrence.

options.text: To keep the dependency at room-weight in the previous item layer
options.why: It has not been updated for this item yet.

options.text: Because every decreasing loop is automatically faster
options.why: The reason is correctness, not universal timing.

options.text: To force exact fill even though the state says at most
options.why: The direction does not change the capacity interpretation.

items.explanation: The dependency layer is part of the proof. A loop direction can silently change which choices are legal.
